notes: The whole image and both existing native overlapping halves were each read once in full. All 22 inventory elements were accounted for. No author page number is visible; the lighter lower-left 97 is archive foliation in another unnamed hand and creates no substantive comparison row.

The first paragraph is a continuation. Its main compatibility clause ends with a period; the interlinear degree addition ends at doit without a written completion. The visibly written degree reference (52) and the display number (52) are retained. No grammatical completion or mathematical renumbering is made.

All 34 existing comparison rows, all 18 decisions and all eight certainty entries were reviewed. The 11 existing doubts are retained. C098-D07 is changed from a settled deleted reading to an explicit deletion-state doubt, bringing the unresolved places to 12.

Two edits are proposed: plain-i connait against both witnesses, and live-first yet uncertain pourtant at existing row 098-36. The latter changes the preferred witness flags to C changed / H unchanged and does not create another counted locus. The former is one new substantive spelling locus.

The first reading interpreted the long line over the right portion of pourtant as cancellation. This history is retained, but the second reading finds that it runs between the t stems above the low a/n bodies and may be their shared crossbar. The word itself is readable. The inventory entry is therefore text with uncertain cancellation rather than an asserted deletion.

The large main Theta qui l’induise remains distinct from the smaller inserted E0 map and compatibility clause. The raised E0 after membership, the older de-like ink beneath it, the small abbreviation below bel and the two separate map endpoint doubts remain exactly located and explicitly marked.

The graphical curves otherwise belong to attachment or cancellation gestures; no missing independent drawing or diagram was found. Stable, et and un retain their observed underlines; macro-only emphasis differences in H are excluded.

The mathematics was followed to distinguish the component functor from the acting group and to preserve the unfinished multiplicity discussion. No independent proof or computation was performed in this audit. The supplied earlier ordinary G-set proof and counterexample remain prior root events and are not duplicated as new check events.
